mode: independent local artifact verification; no experiment or threshold mutation

data_and_calibration.local_holdout_claim: image-heldout for this cycle; prior-use scan does not establish absence from model pretraining

model_evidence_scope.scope: prior full 4-shard weight/tokenizer/config SHA256 audit plus matching runtime config/index/tokenizer_config fingerprints

limits: Local frozen source files, archived job snapshots and runtime-declared hashes were verified; this is not an exhaustive import-tree or remote process-memory attestation.
Historical legacy_scripts helpers and official KIVI codec are imported by frozen core from the historical directory; not every transitive dependency has an individually recorded launch hash.
All model weights were fully hashed before evaluation, while runtime manifests fingerprint config/index/tokenizer_config; this audit did not reread remote weight shards after inference.
All 64 local input image hashes match frozen sample metadata; remote image bytes were not rehashed by this local audit during generation.
The common 16 MiB allowance is not exact realized-read matching. Per-policy observed ranges are retained.
Probe controller local two-read charges include one normal read; global extra was recomputed only from actual fused-call residuals plus replay/repair/probe base/text rereads.
